market_mood.explanation_en: Score of 61.2 sits in constructive territory, like a boat moving forward with a steady but not strong tailwind. Investors can consider selective buys but should keep position sizes modest because macro cross-currents remain active.

big_picture.summary_en: U.S. 10-year Treasury yields reached multi-decade highs near 24-year peaks, triggering equity selling pressure that later partially reversed. Oil surged over 4% after reports of a third U.S. aircraft carrier heading to the Middle East and China halting fuel exports.

big_picture.vix_note_en: VIX sits at 16.39, indicating calm rather than fear or overconfidence; volatility is not the dominant market driver today.
big_picture.vix_note_ko: VIX가 16.39에 머물러 있어 공포나 과신 어느 쪽도 아닌 안정된 상태입니다. 변동성은 오늘 시장의 주된 변수가 아닙니다.
big_picture.rates_note_en: 10-year yield at 5.24% remains elevated and continues to pressure growth valuations through higher discount rates.
